PropertySetDef.Name: Pset_ElementQuantities
PropertySetDef.Definition: Definition from IAI: Properties about the quantity, orientation and inclination of elements. Can be attached to all IfcElement.

PropertyDef.Name: QuantityCalcStandard
PropertyDef.Definition: The standard by which the quantities in this Pset are calculated. If not specified, measures are simple geometry calculations

PropertyDef.Name: LengthQuantity
PropertyDef.Definition: The 1D length of this element (measured according to the standard). If standard not specified, then simple calculation of 1D length.

PropertyDef.Name: AreaQuantity
PropertyDef.Definition: The 2D area of this element (measured according to the standard). If standard not specified, then simple calculation of 2D surface area.

PropertyDef.Name: VolumeQuantity
PropertyDef.Definition: The 3D volume of this element (measured according to the standard). If standard not specified, then simple 3D volume calculation.

PropertyDef.Name: WeightQuantity
PropertyDef.Definition: The weight of this element (measured according to the standard). If standard not specified, then physical weight as calculated from volumne and density.

PropertyDef.Name: CountQuantity
PropertyDef.Definition: The count (number) of the element (measured according to the standard).

PropertyDef.Name: LengthQuantityDescription
PropertyDef.Definition: Description for or about the length quantity value extraction

PropertyDef.Name: AreaQuantityDescription
PropertyDef.Definition: Description for or about the area quantity value extraction

PropertyDef.Name: VolumeQuantityDescription
PropertyDef.Definition: Description for or about the volume quantity value extraction

PropertyDef.Name: WeightQuantityDescription
PropertyDef.Definition: Description for or about the weight quantity value extraction

PropertyDef.Name: CountQuantityDescription
PropertyDef.Definition: Description for or about the count quantity value extraction

PropertyDef.Name: Azimuth
PropertyDef.Definition: Azimuth of the element as derived from the placement of the element shape, by convention: North = 0' and measurement is done clockwise (I.e. south = 90', if unit is grad) ? The calculation procedure will be specific for each type of element. The following translations apply: G: Himmelsrichtung des Bauteils, J: HOUI-KAKU

PropertyDef.Name: Inclination
PropertyDef.Definition: Azimuth of the element as derived from the placement of the element shape, by convention: Vertical = 0', horizontal = 90', if unit is grad) ? The calculation procedure will be specific for each type of element. The following translations apply: G: Bauteilneigung, J: KEISHA-KAKU
